newsitem.title: BELGIUM: US Gen. Wesley Clark to be NATO's chief in Europe.
newsitem.headline: US Gen. Wesley Clark to be NATO's chief in Europe.

text.p: U.S. General Wesley Clark has been chosen to succeed General George Joulwan as Supreme Commander of the Allied Forces in Europe, NATO said in a statement on Wednesday.
The statement said Clark would replace Joulwan in July. The army general's nomination must still be ratified by the U.S. Senate.
NATO's Defence Planning Committee had expressed its thanks to Joulwan for his "eminent services rendered", the statement said.
Joulwan oversaw NATO's operation in Bosnia, its biggest ever. NATO currently has about 21,000 troops in the region.
Clark will oversee the rest of the mission, which U.S. President Bill Clinton has said is to end by the summer of 1998.
